goal: Refactor all agent.call() prompt construction sites to use a new PromptBuilder class, separate ROLE+RULES into system prompt, externalize OUTPUT FORMAT as structured output via provider jsonSchemaFlag, and maximize user prompt prefix sharing for cache efficiency.

in: [must] provider.js — add jsonSchemaFlag() to each provider class
[must] agent.js — add jsonSchema handling with fallback for unsupported providers
[must] All 14 agent.call() sites migrated to PromptBuilder
[should] JSON Schema definitions for each JSON-output prompt type
[must] Unit tests for PromptBuilder, jsonSchemaFlag, agent jsonSchema handling
out: Data-level redundancy reduction (spec JSON tasks array repetition, spec+diff duplication)

constraints: No external dependencies (Node.js built-in modules only)
Alpha policy: no backward-compatible shims for old prompt construction patterns
PromptBuilder must be provider-agnostic — no knowledge of CLI flags or provider specifics
OOP class design per project coding rules
design_principles: Provider-agnostic PromptBuilder returns structured data; agent.js handles provider-specific flag injection
Shared prompt parts at user prompt head, variable parts at tail — enforced by PromptBuilder API, not convention
Fallback for unsupported providers: FMT text embedded in user prompt when jsonSchemaFlag() returns null

modules.text: src/lib/prompt-builder.js — New. Provider-agnostic prompt structuring. Returns { systemPrompt, userPrompt, jsonSchema }.
src/lib/provider.js — Extended. Add jsonSchemaFlag() method to Provider base, ClaudeProvider, CodexProvider, UserProvider.
src/lib/agent.js — Extended. _buildInvocation() gains jsonSchema parameter handling with provider-specific flag injection and fallback.

data_flow.text: Call site → PromptBuilder.setRole/setRules/setJsonSchema/add → build() → { systemPrompt, userPrompt, jsonSchema }
agent.call(userPrompt, { systemPrompt, jsonSchema }) → _buildInvocation() → provider-specific CLI args

decisions.text: All 14 agent.call() sites are migrated, including impl-guardrail which Issue #290 marked as 'on hold'. The 'hold' referred to diff-related changes, not prompt structure migration.
decisions.evidence: buildGuardrailPromptFromFiltered (run-gate.js:522) is shared across spec/draft/impl-guardrail. Splitting would create two parallel prompt builders.

decisions.text: PromptBuilder is provider-agnostic. Fallback for structured output is handled by agent.js, not PromptBuilder.
decisions.evidence: Issue #290 design: PromptBuilder.build() returns jsonSchema; agent.call() checks provider.jsonSchemaFlag() and either passes the schema via CLI flag or embeds FMT text in user prompt.

decisions.text: User prompt prefix maximization is enforced by PromptBuilder's add() ordering — shared data first, variable data last.
decisions.evidence: Measured data (8cae): spec/draft/impl-guardrail share FMT+RULES+ARTICLES but cache misses due to differing ROLE prefix. Moving ROLE to system prompt and ordering shared data first aligns prefixes.

background: Agent invocations across the SDD flow have a 38.5% cache read rate. The primary bottleneck is prefix mismatch: ROLE sentences differ between phases, and variable data splits fixed data, preventing cache sharing. Issue #290 (parent task 0003) addresses this through prompt layer optimization.

requirements.desc: Create PromptBuilder class in src/lib/prompt-builder.js with methods: setRole(text), setRules(text), setJsonSchema(schema), setFmtFallback(text), add(header, content). build() returns { systemPrompt, userPrompt, jsonSchema }. systemPrompt = role + rules joined. userPrompt = add() sections in declaration order. jsonSchema = the schema object as-is.

Add jsonSchemaFlag() method to Provider base class (returns null), ClaudeProvider (returns '--json-schema'), CodexProvider (returns '--output-schema'), and UserProvider (returns profile.jsonSchemaFlag or null).

Extend agent.js _buildInvocation() to accept options.jsonSchema. When provider.jsonSchemaFlag() is non-null: for claude, add [flag, JSON.stringify(schema)] to args; for codex, write schema to a temp file and add [flag, tempFilePath] to args. When jsonSchemaFlag() is null and options.jsonSchema is provided: prepend the fmtFallback text (from PromptBuilder) to userPrompt.

Migrate all 14 agent.call() sites to use PromptBuilder. Each site constructs a PromptBuilder, sets role/rules/jsonSchema/content sections, calls build(), and passes the result to agent.call(). The 14 sites are: run-gate.js (×2), run-auto-check.js, run-retro.js, get-context.js, review.js, translate.js, enrich.js, init.js, text.js, agents.js, forge.js, template-merger.js.

Define JSON Schema objects for each JSON-output prompt type. At minimum: guardrail evaluation schema (used by run-gate), auto-check scoring schema, retro evaluation schema, context-search schema, enrich batch schema, init chapter selection schema, text directive schema.

Add unit tests under specs/247-prompt-layer-optimization/tests/: PromptBuilder build() output structure, section ordering, fmtFallback embedding when jsonSchema is set but no provider flag. Agent _buildInvocation with jsonSchema for claude/codex/user providers. Provider jsonSchemaFlag() return values. All existing tests pass (npm test + npm run test:agent).
Remove old prompt construction patterns from migrated call sites. No FMT/OUTPUT FORMAT text blocks remain inline in call sites that have been migrated to PromptBuilder with structured output.

acceptance_criteria: PromptBuilder class exists at src/lib/prompt-builder.js and is importable
All 3 built-in providers return correct jsonSchemaFlag() values
agent.js _buildInvocation produces correct CLI args when jsonSchema is provided (per provider)
No inline OUTPUT FORMAT text blocks remain in migrated call sites
npm run test:agent passes (regression check for agent.js changes)
Representative prompts (guardrail, auto-check) show structural token reduction (FMT removal + ROLE separation)

Impact on existing features: all AI-powered commands affected (docs: enrich, text, translate, init, forge, agents, template-merger; flow: gate, auto-check, retro, context-search, review). Prompt content is identical but restructured. No user-visible behavior change.

alternatives_considered.option: Split impl-guardrail into separate function to keep old prompt style
alternatives_considered.reason: Rejected: buildGuardrailPromptFromFiltered is shared across all guardrail phases. Splitting creates two parallel builders with higher maintenance cost.

alternatives_considered.option: Let call sites manage prompt ordering instead of PromptBuilder
alternatives_considered.reason: Rejected: ordering mistakes would silently degrade cache efficiency. PromptBuilder enforces correct ordering by design.

alternatives_considered.option: Compare runtime cache hit rates before/after
alternatives_considered.reason: Not adopted as primary success criterion: runtime conditions vary and results are not reproducible. Structural reduction (FMT removal, ROLE separation) is verifiable from code.
